The '''New Mandalorian customs department''' was the governmental agency of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] regime that processed all arriving [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] and goods on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the agency was rife with corruption.
